item.title: Wall Street Poised for Record Profits
item.description: Data: NYSE/Intercontinental Exchange via the New York State Comptroller; Chart by Emily Peck/Axios; Note: 2026 projection by the comptroller based on first-half figures.

item.title: Unknowns delay U.S. plague response
item.description: Two major unknowns hinder assessment of the plague threat in Russia and decisions on travel advisories and port restrictions.

item.title: Trump targets the words Americans use
item.description: President Trump has a history of nicknaming opponents, and with November approaching, he is now attempting to shape the vocabulary around key issues.

item.title: Senate GOP super PAC to spend $5m in South Carolina
item.description: The main super PAC backing Republican Senate candidates plans to invest $5 million in the South Carolina race as an insurance policy.
